findings.title: Missing cache recheck after acquiring write lock causes thundering herd
findings.body: The fast path checks `entryPointAssetsCache` under `RLock`, then releases the lock. If it is nil, the function takes the write lock at line 48 but never re-reads `entryPointAssetsCache`. When several goroutines call `GetWebAssets` concurrently before the cache is populated, they all pass the nil check and then serialize on the write lock; each one repeats the expensive manifest load (file or CDN) and overwrites the cache. Add a second cache check immediately after acquiring the write lock and return the cached value if it is now non-nil.

findings.title: No regression test for the data race fix
findings.body: This change fixes a data race on the global `entryPointAssetsCache`, but no test exercises concurrent calls to `GetWebAssets`. A test that invokes `GetWebAssets` from multiple goroutines concurrently, ideally run under `go test -race`, would verify that the mutex protects the cache and would prevent the original race from being reintroduced.
